economic_hypothesis: The first causal BULL session after five consecutive non-BULL sessions is a breadth-thrust regime birth. On that completed session, industries already above the cross-industry median and stocks making their first twenty-session high on expanded turnover identify early price discovery rather than mature-trend chasing.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open

market.birth: current BULL and each of prior five completed market sessions non-BULL

state.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
state.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
state.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
state.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

stock.first_breakout: close>=prior20 high; previous close<its then-prior20 high
